categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' maintainer label and fixes exit code error handling in the `bitcoin-wallet` CLI tool.
categories.rationale: Fixes `bitcoin-wallet create` incorrectly returning exit code 0 upon wallet creation failure. The PR notes that running `bitcoin-wallet create` twice prints 'Database already exists.' yet produces exit code 0 (`echo $?` -> 0), which misleads automated scripts relying on process status codes.
